title: AI Comment Generator with Enhanced UI and 3D Elements

requirements.text: Add comment length selection dropdown to AiCommentGenerator component with three options: Short (50-100 words), Medium (100-200 words), and Long (200-300 words). Pass the selected length to the generation logic.

quotes: Add Comment Length Selection: Add a new UI input field (a dropdown or toggle buttons) allowing users to select the length of the generated comments (e.g., Short, Medium, Long, or exact word counts).

acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown appears in AiCommentGenerator form with Short/Medium/Long options
Selected length is passed to comment generation function
Default selection is Medium

requirements.text: Enhance the comment generation algorithm in AiCommentGenerator to guarantee completely fresh, unique comments on every generation. Use randomized sentence structures, varied vocabulary pools, dynamic adjectives, and timestamp-based seeding to prevent any duplicate outputs. Integrate the rating symbol naturally into the generated text.

quotes: Fresh Generation Logic: Update the backend/API prompt logic to guarantee that every generation creates completely fresh, unique, and live comments every time the 'Generate' button is clicked, preventing any duplicate or cached results.

acceptanceCriteria: Each generation produces completely unique comments with no repetition
Rating symbol is seamlessly integrated into comment text
Comments vary in structure, vocabulary, and phrasing
Timestamp-based seeding ensures different results each time

requirements.text: Fix the list visibility glitch in AiCommentTable so that generated comments appear instantly and correctly below the generation card as soon as the user clicks 'Generate'. Ensure proper state management and DOM updates.

quotes: Instant Visibility & State Fix: Fix the glitch where lists aren't showing up correctly. The generated comment list should instantly appear below the generation card as soon as the user clicks 'Generate'.

acceptanceCriteria: Comment list appears immediately after generation without requiring page refresh
No delay or blank state between generation and display
Comments render in the correct order

requirements.text: Implement a skeleton loader in AiCommentTable that displays while comments are being generated. Add a smooth typing effect animation that reveals each comment character-by-character after it's fetched to create a real-time streaming appearance.

quotes: Real-Time Streaming/Loading: Reduce perceived response time by implementing a skeleton loader or a real-time streaming effect (typing effect) as the comments are being fetched and rendered.

acceptanceCriteria: Skeleton loader shows while waiting for generation to complete
Typing effect animates each comment appearing character-by-character
Animation speed is smooth and natural (not too fast or slow)
Loading state transitions smoothly to typed content

requirements.text: Create a lightweight 3D rotating cube using pure CSS 3D transforms and integrate it into the AdminPanel AI Comments tab. Position it strategically to complement the dark theme and purple/pink gradients without cluttering the form area. The cube should rotate continuously and smoothly.

quotes: 3D Rotating Cube: Integrate a lightweight, visually appealing 3D rotating cube model into the user view (use CSS 3D transforms or React Three Fiber if a heavy library is already installed).

acceptanceCriteria: 3D cube uses only CSS 3D transforms (no heavy libraries)
Cube rotates continuously on multiple axes
Positioned to enhance aesthetics without blocking form elements
Matches dark theme with purple/pink gradient styling
Performance remains smooth with no lag

requirements.text: Optimize the loading speed of AiCommentGenerator component by ensuring all async operations (comment generation, API calls) don't block the main thread. Use proper React Query hooks with optimistic updates and ensure mutations complete efficiently.

quotes: Speed Optimization: Optimize the loading speed of the component. Ensure API calls are handled asynchronously without blocking the main thread.

acceptanceCriteria: Comment generation doesn't freeze the UI
Main thread remains responsive during operations
Loading states provide clear feedback
Component renders quickly on initial load

requirements.text: Polish the UI of AiCommentGenerator and AiCommentTable with smooth hover states, proper spacing, clean transitions, and modern styling. Keep the existing dark theme with purple/pink gradients but enhance button interactions, input focus states, and card shadows for a snappier, more modern feel.

quotes: UI Polish: Improve the overall UI/UX of the form. Ensure inputs, buttons, and dashboard cards have smooth hover states, proper padding, and clean transitions. Keep the existing dark theme with purple/pink gradients but make it feel more modern and snappy.

acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements have smooth hover transitions
Input fields show clear focus states
Buttons have press feedback with scale/shadow effects
Consistent padding and spacing throughout
Dark theme with purple/pink gradients maintained
Transitions are smooth (200-300ms) and feel responsive

constraints: Use pure CSS 3D transforms for the rotating cube, not React Three Fiber or WebGL libraries
Maintain the existing dark theme with purple/pink gradient color scheme
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity hooks, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or components/ui
Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Comment generation must work without external AI API integrations
nonGoals: Integrating external AI services like OpenAI or Anthropic
Using React Three Fiber or heavy 3D libraries
Changing the overall application architecture or technology stack
Adding WebSocket support for real-time streaming
Modifying the backend Motoko actor structure beyond what's necessary
